summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the new /menu page and navigation changes for Bansi Vihar. All 6 categories render with correct item counts (7/4/6/4/5/5 = 31 items total), INR prices, signature sparkle icons (6 sparkles visible), sticky category tabs smooth-scroll to sections, WhatsApp CTA points to wa.me/919431045221, and all routing flows work: Menu nav link routes to /menu, Hero 'Explore Menu' CTA routes to /menu, Footer Menu link routes to /menu, logo/Back-to-Home returns to /, Story nav from /menu routes home and scrolls to #story, Reserve CTA on /menu routes home. Zero console errors during navigation between / and /menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu.jsx active tab state only updates on click; consider IntersectionObserver to highlight current category on natural scroll for better UX.
Navbar.handleNav uses setTimeout(150ms) for cross-route anchor scroll which can be flaky on slow loads; consider awaiting route render via useEffect on location.hash.
Sticky tabs use top-[72px] hardcoded offset; if navbar height changes this will misalign.
menu.js uses item.name as React key — works today but could collide if duplicate names are added; consider slug+index.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu page at /menu fully functional. Test IDs verified: menu-page, menu-back-home, menu-tab-{slug}, menu-category-{slug}, menu-item-{slug}-{i}, menu-cta-whatsapp. Slugs: south-indian, thalis, chinese, fast-food, shakes, desserts. Item counts: 7/4/6/4/5/5. Note: problem statement mentioned 'menu-tab-culinary-vihar' but actual implementation uses category slug — the slug variant is correct/expected.
